title: Status
description: How far a file has been checked, and by whom.

level.description: draft: work in progress. imported: copied by a tool from an open dataset, not checked by a person. checked: one person checked every value against its cited place. verified: two different people did. needs-review: a source changed or a problem was reported. disputed: sources disagree.

checked_by.description: GitHub handles of the people who checked (checked: 1 or more, verified: 2 or more).

against.description: Ids of the sources the check used.

imported_from.description: For imported files: which importer, which source, where in it, and when.
